title: Work package
description: Everything the agent needs to judge one change request, as handed out by the next command: the rules that apply, the checklist, the criteria, the changed files with their code, and the signals. The next command may serve it in parts; the work package itself is one document. The judgement path and related work packages are relative to the run's work directory.

runId.description: Run the work package belongs to.

url.description: Web address of the change request.

description.description: Description of the change request, in Markdown.

headSha.description: Head commit to judge; the judgement must repeat it.

baseSha.description: Target branch commit the diff is computed against.

baseRef.description: Target branch, where the criteria are read from.

profileReason.description: Why the profile was chosen, in a few words, for example set in .agent-code-review/config.json.

dimensions.description: Repository dimensions of the packs in use, by dimension id (lowercase words joined by hyphens), with the value chosen and why. File dimensions, such as platform, vary per file and are not listed.

additionalProperties.description: The value of one dimension and why it was chosen.

reason.description: Why the value was chosen, in a few words.

files.description: Criteria files read on the target branch, relative to the repository root, in the order they were read.

ignored.description: Parts of the repository criteria that are not applied, each with the reason, for the Repository criteria ignored section of the report.

item.description: What is ignored and where, for example `no-double-bang` in disabledRules (.agent-code-review/config.json).

rules.description: Rules that apply to the change request: the core rules, then those of each active pack in activation order, then the repository rules, each in catalog order. Conditions on the profile and the repository dimensions are already applied; conditions on file dimensions, such as platform, are checked per file. Disabled repository rules are left out.

id.description: Rule identifier to use in findings.

severity.description: Severity of the rule: of the catalog, or of the repository criteria.

title.description: One-line summary of the rule; for a repository rule, its text.

source.description: Where the rule comes from: core, repository, or the id of the pack that defines it.

group.description: Checklist section the rule is listed under; absent when it has none.

needsJudgement.description: True when the signals of the rule need a decision of the judgement.

options.description: Resolved values of the overridable parameters of the rule, by name: the catalog value or the one the repository set.

checklist.description: Checklist for the agent, generated from the rules: the pack and core rules grouped by their group, then the repository rules in their own section.

sections.description: Sections of pack and core rules, in the order their group first appears in the rules.

heading.description: Group of the rules; absent for the rules that have none.

rules.description: Ids of the rules of the section, in order.

repository.description: Ids of the repository rules, in order.

files.description: Changed files, in diff order. Files that are not reviewed are listed here too, without code, and in notVerified.

path.description: Path in the change request; for a removed file, its old path.

previousPath.description: Old path of a renamed or copied file.

language.description: Language identifier from the pack that covers the file; absent when no pack covers it.

placement.description: inline when the diff shows lines of the file, so findings can be anchored on them; summary when it shows none, as for a file without a patch or a rename without changes.

reason.description: Why a file is placed in the summary, for example patch-unavailable or renamed-without-changes.

diff.description: The hunks of the unified diff of the file; absent when the diff shows no lines.

code.description: Code of the file at the head commit, with line numbers: the whole file when it is short, else regions around the hunks. Absent for a removed file, a file no pack covers, and a file whose diff shows no lines.

whole.description: True when regions holds the whole file in one region.

regions.description: Regions of the file, in line order, neither overlapping nor adjacent.

start.description: Line number of the first line.

signals.description: Places in the changed files that the mechanical rules point at, each with a short id. The judgement must decide every signal that needs judgement; the others become findings unless the judgement dismisses them.

items.description: One signal. Its severity is null exactly when its rule needs judgement.

id.description: Short id the judgement refers to: s1, s2, and so on, unique in the work package.

rule.description: Rule that points at the place.

severity.description: Severity of the rule; null when the rule needs judgement, which then decides it.

path.description: File path in the change request.

side.description: Side of line: RIGHT, the head commit, by default; LEFT, the base, for a place the change request removes, such as a removed declaration.

line.description: Line on side: at the head commit (RIGHT) unless side says LEFT.

column.description: Column of the first character, starting at 1.

origin.description: mr when the change request adds the line, existing when the line is already on the target branch; existing signals become pre-existing findings.

needsJudgement.description: True when the rule cannot decide alone: the judgement confirms the signal with a severity or dismisses it.

references.description: Other places in the code the signal relies on, possibly in other projects, for example the uses of a removed symbol. A finding made from the signal keeps them.

notVerified.description: Changed files, or parts of them, that the rules could not check, and why.

items.description: One file that was not reviewed.

path.description: File path in the change request.

reason.description: generated: marked as generated; binary: no text diff; patch-unavailable: the platform omitted the diff; noise: matches a noise glob; unsupported-language: no pack covers it; match-budget-exceeded: a rule ran out of matching steps on the file, and detail names the rule; tree-unavailable: a change-request rule could not read the repository tree at head for the file, and detail names the rule; search-unavailable: a change-request rule could not search the code for a symbol of the file, and detail names the rule and the symbol.

detail.description: Optional human-readable detail; required for match-budget-exceeded, tree-unavailable and search-unavailable, where it starts with the rule.

relatedChanges.description: Other change requests reviewed in the same cascade, so that changes made together are not reported as missing.

cr.description: Key of the related change request.

workPackage.description: Its work package, when it is in the same run.

cascade.description: Where the change request is in the cascade.

ancestors.description: Change requests above it, from the root down to the one that lists it; empty for the root.

parts.description: How the work package is served: each part carries whole files within a byte budget, in diff order. Part 1 also carries the header, checklist, criteria, cascade and change-request signals.

changeRequestSignals.description: Ids of the signals of the change-request rules, served in part 1.

files.description: Paths of the files of each part, part 1 first; one entry per part.

items.description: The files of one part, in diff order.

judgementPath.description: Where the agent writes its judgement.

criteriaSource.description: Where the criteria come from: overlay is .agent-code-review/, legacy is .github/skills and .github/mr-review.json, default is the packs alone.

dimensionId.description: Identifier of a dimension or of one of its values: lowercase words joined by hyphens.

line.description: Line number, starting at 1, in the file version of the chosen side.

packId.description: Stack pack identifier, for example android or kotlin-multiplatform.

profile.description: Kind of repository, which selects the default criteria.

reference.description: Another place in the code that a finding relies on, possibly in another project.

ref.description: Branch, tag or commit SHA the line refers to.

relativePath.description: Relative path with forward slashes, without empty, '.' or '..' segments.

ruleId.description: Rule identifier: lowercase words joined by hyphens, optionally in dot-separated groups, for example no-double-bang.

runId.description: Identifier of a review run, also the name of its work directory.

severity.description: Severity of a finding, from the most to the least serious.

sha.description: Full commit SHA, 40 lowercase hexadecimal characters.
